source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDMLOptionsTest { @isTest static void optionsShapeAndAllOrNone() { Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); System.assertEquals(false, opts.optAllOrNone); opts.optAllOrNone = false; opts.allowFieldTruncation = false; opts.assignmentRuleHeader.useDefaultRule = true; opts.assignmentRuleHeader.assignmentRuleID = '01Q000000000001AAA'; opts.emailHeader.triggerUserEmail = true; opts.emailHeader.triggerAutoResponseEmail = true; opts.emailHeader.triggerOtherEmail = true; System.assertEquals(false, opts.optAllOrNone); System.assertEquals(false, opts.allowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(true, opts.assignmentRuleHeader.useDefaultRule); System.assertEquals('01Q000000000001AAA', opts.assignmentRuleHeader.assignmentRuleID); System.assertEquals(true, opts.emailHeader.triggerUserEmail); System.assertEquals(true, opts.emailHeader.triggerAutoResponseEmail); System.assertEquals(true, opts.emailHeader.triggerOtherEmail); System.assertNotEquals(null, opts.localeOptions); opts.DuplicateRuleHeader.AllowSave = true; opts.DuplicateRuleHeader.RunAsCurrentUser = true; opts.LocalizeErrors = true; opts.AllowFieldTruncation = true; opts.OptAllOrNone = false; System.assertEquals(true, opts.DuplicateRuleHeader.AllowSave); System.assertEquals(true, opts.DuplicateRuleHeader.RunAsCurrentUser); System.assertEquals(true, opts.LocalizeErrors); System.assertEquals(true, opts.AllowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(false, opts.OptAllOrNone); Database.DMLOptions copied = (Database.DMLOptions)opts.clone(); System.assertEquals(true, copied.DuplicateRuleHeader.AllowSave); System.assertEquals(true, copied.LocalizeErrors); System.assertEquals(false, copied.OptAllOrNone); Account good = new Account(Name = 'Good'); Account bad = new Account(); List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(new List<Account>{good, bad}, opts); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!results[1].isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult singleOptions = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'Option Single'), opts); System.assert(singleOptions.isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult plainUpdated = Database.update(new Account(Id = singleOptions.getId(), Name = 'Option Single Updated'), opts); System.assert(plainUpdated.isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult one = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'One'), opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(one.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> many = Database.insert(new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Two'), new Account(Name = 'Three')}, opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, many.size()); System.assert(many[1].isSuccess()); List<Account> optionRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name IN ('Two', 'Three') ORDER BY Name]; List<Database.SaveResult> plainUpdatedMany = Database.update(new List<Account>{new Account(Id = optionRows[0].Id, Name = 'Two Plain Updated'), new Account(Id = optionRows[1].Id, Name = 'Three Plain Updated')}, opts); System.assertEquals(2, plainUpdatedMany.size()); System.assert(plainUpdatedMany[0].isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(new Account(Id = one.getId(), Name = 'One Updated'), opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name IN ('Two Plain Updated', 'Three Plain Updated') ORDER BY Name]; List<Database.SaveResult> updatedMany = Database.update(new List<Account>{new Account(Id = rows[0].Id, Name = 'Two Updated'), new Account(Id = rows[1].Id, Name = 'Three Updated')}, opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, updatedMany.size()); System.assert(updatedMany[0].isSuccess()); } }
